# `worktree`

> Profile: deferred · Permission key: `[permission] worktree`

Git worktree helpers under `.whycodes/worktrees/`. Actions: create, list, remove, enter (switch tool cwd), exit (restore project root). Use to isolate experimental edits without touching the main checkout.

Deferred tools are not advertised on every request. Activate one with `tool_search` or set `session.tool_profile = "full"`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | one of `create`, `list`, `remove`, `enter`, `exit` | yes | create \| list \| remove \| enter \| exit |
| `name` | string | no | Worktree name (create/remove/enter) |
